tradeoff.rule: publishable fleet-corrected scenario with pareto_eligible=true and feasibility_status='pass'; the exogenous harvest ladder and the allocation-LP family are sensitivity/compare only and are never Pareto eligible
tradeoff.harvest_exogenous_caveat: Harvest is exogenous and free in this model; higher harvest lowers cost and emissions because no harvest cost/THLB/AAC constraint is modeled. This is a sensitivity ladder, not a policy frontier.
tradeoff.allocation_caveat: The operable-proxy intensity screen uses SCANFI merchantable area intersected with a share-based 2016 tenure proxy, not a THLB. It has no slope, road access, age/disturbance, growth, yield, or economic content. 150 Mm3 is conditional: the 1.0 m3/ha/yr per-province screen is infeasible by 16.296 Mm3, and the 1.2 screen is still short by 4.492 Mm3 because BC, ON, YT, and NT documented caps bind below 1.2 x operable area. The national operable envelope alone would clear 150 Mm3 at 1.2. 119 Mm3 passes both. The LP allocation is a comparison/screening result, not a legal AAC, enforced provincial constraint, or policy frontier.
tradeoff.feasibility_caveat: 200 Mm3 is not admissible under documented AAC/NFD; 150 Mm3 is conditional (national bound only; the LP reallocates it, but the 1.0 m3/ha/yr operable-proxy screen fails by 16.296 Mm3 and the 1.2 screen is still short by 4.492 Mm3 because BC/ON/YT/NT documented caps bind; the national operable envelope alone clears at 1.2). Harvest is exogenous and free. The default energy Pareto contains only the canonical 119 Mm3 fleet scenario. Allocation-LP variants are comparison/context only.
